verified_facts.text: Fairmont Pacific Rim is located in the heart of Vancouver.
verified_facts.excerpt: Fairmont Pacific Rim is a Forbes Five-Star hotel located in the heart of Vancouver.

verified_facts.text: The hotel's art collection was established under the direction of owners and developers Westbank and the Peterson Group.
verified_facts.excerpt: Fairmont Pacific Rim established its art collection under the direction of owners and developers Westbank and the Peterson Group.

verified_facts.text: The Pacific Gallery is an intimate exhibition space showing works by established and emerging artists from Canada and around the world, in partnership with the Equinox Gallery and Westbank.
verified_facts.excerpt: In partnership with the Equinox Gallery and Westbank, our intimate exhibition space showcases works of art by accomplished and emerging visionary talent from across Canada and the world.

verified_facts.text: A dedicated library on the second floor holds over 275 TASCHEN books, from artist monographs to signed Collector's Editions.
verified_facts.excerpt: Explore over 275 TASCHEN books, ranging from artist monographs to signed Collector’s Editions, in our dedicated Library on the second floor.

verified_facts.text: Suite X, a Fairmont Gold one-bedroom suite, was designed by artist Douglas Coupland and has a private patio, artist-designed art installations and custom furnishings.
verified_facts.excerpt: Designed by celebrated artist Douglas Coupland, this expansive suite offers luxury living, complete with private patio and breathtaking views. Features include artist designed vibrant art installations

verified_facts.text: Dining and drinking venues include the restaurant Botanist, Botanist Bar, and The Lobby Lounge & RawBar, which serves sushi and drinks.
verified_facts.excerpt: Discover the best of the Pacific Northwest at Botanist, award-winning cocktails at Botanist Bar and exceptional sushi and drinks at The Lobby Lounge & RawBar.

verified_facts.text: Giovane is a more casual Italian bakery and cafe serving pasta, pizza, panini and desserts.
verified_facts.excerpt: There’s also the more casual Giovane, an Italian bakery and café that serves pasta, pizza, panini, and desserts.

verified_facts.text: Fairmont Spa is on the fifth floor of the hotel.
verified_facts.excerpt: Fairmont Pacific Rim is home to a Forbes Five-Star spa, located on the fifth floor of the hotel.

verified_facts.text: Guest rooms and suites have Stearns & Foster beds, marble bathrooms and a variety of city and mountain views.
verified_facts.excerpt: feature dreamy Stearns & Foster beds, spacious spa-like marble bathrooms and a variety of city and mountain views.

verified_facts.text: Signature Ofuro rooms have a Japanese deep soaker ofuro jetted tub in an oversized marble bathroom, with views of Coal Harbour and the North Shore Mountains.
verified_facts.excerpt: Signature Ofuro rooms boast Vancouver's most stunning views of Coal Harbour and North Shore Mountains, enjoyed from a Japanese deep soaker ofuro jetted tub in an oversized marble bathroom.

verified_facts.text: Deluxe Pool View rooms have private patios or balconies, some with outdoor fireplaces, overlooking the pool terrace, cabanas and palm trees.
verified_facts.excerpt: Deluxe Pool View rooms offer private patios or balconies, some with outdoor fireplaces, overlooking the hotels pool terrace, cabanas and palm trees.

verified_facts.text: The hotel has a spa, a rooftop pool and a fitness center.
verified_facts.excerpt: five-star hotel spa, rooftop pool and fitness center, all moments from the city's top attractions.

verified_facts.text: The Chairmans Suite is a two-story, villa-style suite with a private gazebo, pond and fire pit, reached by private elevator.
verified_facts.excerpt: This two-story, villa-style masterpiece includes two living rooms, Swarovski crystal chandelier, pantry, fireplace, ensuite marble bathroom with hand-carved soaker tub, outdoor patio, private gazebo, pond and fire pit.

verified_facts.text: Fairmont Gold guests have access to the Fairmont Gold Lounge, which overlooks Stanley Park, the harbour and the mountains.
verified_facts.excerpt: Relax in the exclusive Fairmont Gold Lounge overlooking Vancouver’s iconic Stanley Park, harbour and mountains.

verified_facts.text: Parking is available for an additional fee.
verified_facts.excerpt: Parking available for an additional fee

verified_facts.text: Vancouver International Airport is around 30-40 minutes from the hotel by car and 40 minutes by Skytrain; the closest Skytrain station is Waterfront.
verified_facts.excerpt: Vancouver International Airport is around 30-40 minutes away by car, and 40 minutes by Skytrain. The closest Skytrain station to the hotel is Waterfront.

verified_facts.text: Cats and dogs are welcome; pets must be on a leash and are asked to stay out of restaurants and bars.
verified_facts.excerpt: We are delighted to welcome cats and dogs to our hotel. Pets must be on a leash at all times and must not be left unattended in the room;

verified_facts.text: Deluxe Partial Harbour View rooms look over the city and part of the harbour, where seaplanes and sailboats can be seen.
verified_facts.excerpt: Our modern contemporary Deluxe Partial Harbour View rooms showcase views spanning the city and partial harbour, where seaplanes and sailboats can be seen.

verified_facts.text: The northern view takes in the living roof of the Vancouver Convention Centre across the street, Burrard Inlet and the North Shore Mountains.
verified_facts.excerpt: the northern view, which takes in the living roof of the dramatic Vancouver Convention Centre across the street, as well as the Burrard Inlet and North Shore Mountains.
